_comment: Merge these two hook entries into ~/.claude/settings.json (fires in every
project on this machine) AND into <inbox repo>/.claude/settings.json (fires
on Claude Desktop and claude.ai/code, where ~/.claude does not exist).
Replace __INBOX_PATH__ with the absolute path to the inbox repo and
Both registrations point at the same script; it is written to survive
running twice per event. Delete this _comment key when merging.
